character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
STRICT REGEN — ZERO IMPROVISATION.

Adult NORMAL man, average build, light/medium skin, low top-down isometric, 8 directions, 92x92, transparent background.

HEAD (LOCKED):
- BALD — no hair, no beard, no mustache, no eyebrows bushy
- Clean shaved scalp, simple readable face from low top-down

OUTFIT MUST BE EXACTLY THIS AND NOTHING ELSE:
- bare chest (skin visible)
- bare arms
- bare legs
- bare feet
- ONLY a tiny plain dark brief / underwear
- NO tank top, NO shirt, NO pants, NO belt, NO shoes, NO socks
- NO armor, NO weapon, NO hat, NO hair

POSE: neutral standing idle, arms at sides, weight on both feet.

DIRECTIONS: South, SE, East, NE, North, NW, West, SW — identical bald head + briefs only.

STYLE: highly detailed pixel art, crisp pixels.

ACCEPTANCE: bald scalp + mostly skin body + tiny dark underwear only. Any hair/clothes/shoes = FAIL.
